mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.group_id, m.profile_id, m.role_in_group, p.name AS profile_name, m.gmt_create, m.gmt_modified FROM ccds_battle_group_member m INNER JOIN ccds_battle_group g ON g.id = m.group_id INNER JOIN ccds_profile p ON p.id = m.profile_id WHERE g.station_id = #{stationId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.sort_no ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_battle_group_member (group_id, profile_id, role_in_group, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{profileId}, #{roleInGroup}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
